exam_name: Đáp án tham khảo đề thi tuyển sinh lớp 10 PTNK năm học 2025–2026, môn Toán chuyên (STAR Education)
license_or_usage_notes: Third-party copyright (STAR Education). Kept locally only (data/exams/raw is gitignored) for internal evaluation; not redistributed; reference solutions are never given to the solver.
extraction: HTML page fetched with curl; the exam + solutions are six PNG images (1654×2339, 2025_PTNK_Toan_CHUYEN_26-5-1..6.png) read visually. No OCR text was stored.
available: All 5 bài / 13 sub-questions (1a–c, 2a–b, 3a–c, 4a–c, 5a–b) with reference solutions; figures for Bài 4 (two diagrams) and Bài 5 (colourings).
notes: STAR states the paper was collected from students and may contain typing errors. Compared with the official paper (ptnk-2025-chuyen-de): Bài 4 omits 'nhọn' (acute); Bài 5 reorders a turn (official: An moves to a new adjacent cell first, then Bình asks; STAR: Bình asks, then An moves), which changes how turns are counted; Bài 2 conditions are paraphrased. Evaluation inputs use the official wording; STAR is used only as the reference.
